title: a nested _values/_alternative action makes zsh report 'bad option'; zshrs completes silently

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0001

_alternative \
  'beta:eq=sign:{ _values '\''back\slash'\'' '\''five[brace{s} here amp&and]'\'' '\''delta[dash-dash --opt]'\'' }' \
  'two:amp&and:_alternative '\''alpha:back\\slash plain:(zeta gamma one)'\'' '\''eps:$HOME path:_files'\'''

observed.notes: zsh rejects the option letters the nested action passes through and prints nine 'bad option' diagnostics instead of a list; zshrs accepts them and renders the matches.

variants.note: superset witness, confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 24 rows differ): the same nine 'bad option' diagnostics PLUS the escaped-colon 'command not found: b' of fixture alternative_escaped_colon_split.

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0000

_alternative \
  'eta:semi;colon:_alternative '\''beta:eq=sign trailing:(theta one six eps)'\'' '\''delta:it'\''\'\'''\''s here star*glob:_files'\''' \
  'gamma:star*glob:(two four alpha zeta)' \
  'five:at@sign:_files' \
  'theta:a\:b colon add files:(three beta)'

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '14 row(s) differ'; this harness computes no fingerprint, so what was re-verified is the verdict and that detail line, not row-for-row identity with `observed`

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
